design: MED012 Dev: original Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct initialization for both arms; QA vs QA+verbatim-note segments
important_limitations: AI review flags are not independent clinician approval.
Eval QA IDs are unseen by MED012 training, but same clinical facts may be present in original notes.
MED011 data are fresh relative to later pilots, but MED000E already learned AMNESIA train QA.
Incorrect patient-code controls are different patients, often different questions/facts; use NLL advantage only as suggestive.
Final is sealed and never opened, even for verification, by this script.
No patient-level machine unlearning is performed.
source_model_required: Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct; do not use MED000E as base
